title: Schedule M-1 and M-2 — Harbor Supply
instructions: Harbor Supply, Inc., a calendar-year C corporation with total assets of $8 million, reports 2025 book net income of **$734,280**. Complete the reconciliation.

exhibits.title: Items in book income
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Federal income tax expense (current and deferred) | 195,720 |
| Net capital loss | 12,000 |
| Business meals (50% deductible) | 14,000 |
| Fines paid to a state agency | 6,000 |
| Premiums on key-person life insurance (Harbor is beneficiary) | 9,000 |
| Interest on municipal bonds | 20,000 |
| Charitable contributions (all within the 10% limit) | 30,000 |
| Book depreciation | 90,000 |

exhibits.title: Other information
exhibits.content:
- Tax depreciation is **$140,000**.
- In December 2025, Harbor received **$18,000** of rent for January–June 2026; the books show it as unearned revenue.
- Retained earnings, January 1, 2025: **$1,200,000**. Cash dividends paid in 2025: **$200,000**.

rows.label: Line 5 — expenses recorded on books not deducted
Income tax (no special deductions or NOL)
rows.explanation: 21% × 912,000 = **191,520** current tax. Book tax expense of 195,720 also includes 4,200 of deferred tax: 21% × (50,000 excess depreciation − 18,000 prepaid rent − 12,000 capital loss carryforward).

rows.label: Prepaid rent
rows.explanation: It reverses when the rent is earned.

rows.label: Depreciation difference
rows.explanation: It reverses over the asset's life.

rows.label: Original due date of the 2025 Form 1120
